entities.summary:
Aurelios Zopyros (b. 400 CE, Athens) was a renowned athlete and sports figure of the Classical era, active in Athens.

He is considered one of the most accomplished athletes of his time, winning numerous championships and setting records in various events.

Zopyros' achievements had a significant impact on the development of athletics in ancient Greece, inspiring future generations of athletes and shaping the sport's early modern structure.

His legacy extends beyond his athletic prowess, as he was also known for his contributions to the cultural and intellectual landscape of Athens during the Classical period.

As a prominent figure in the city's athletic scene, Zopyros was celebrated for his remarkable speed, agility, and endurance, which earned him the admiration of his peers and the respect of his competitors.
